title: Figure 15: Object Sightings by Reported Shape of Object with Evaluation Distribution
description: A vertical stacked bar on the left divides sightings into shape groups: Elliptical (47.0%), Rocket and aircraft, Meteor or comet, Lenticular conical or teardrop, Flame (4.8%), Other (11.2%) and Not stated (23.5%). Dashed lines connect each shape group to a horizontal bar on the right showing its evaluation breakdown (Astronomical, Aircraft, Balloon, Insuf. info., Other, Unknown), with the x-axis labeled "Evaluation in Per Cent". Caption: "FIGURE 15 DISTRIBUTION OF OBJECT SIGHTINGS BY SHAPE OF OBJECT(S) REPORTED WITH EVALUATION DISTRIBUTION FOR EACH SHAPE GROUP"; drawing A-7493.
